cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Outside the Scope
cards.instruction: Redirect personal or dangerous questions by declaring them irrelevant, premature, or assigned to another process.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Whether I broke the window is outside this repair meeting's scope.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then let's hold a responsibility meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. After the repairs. We need a safe venue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Location changes require a separate planning discussion.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 solution to invent another prerequisite, developing the same jurisdictional deferral.
